text: dsh-feishu（DSH 插件，飞书 IM）：把 DSH 接入飞书，让用户在聊天中向默认模型发消息并接收回复。插件注册 Feishu channel bridge，支持本机 lark-cli 事件消费和 HTTP relay；按聊天创建常驻 Agent、串行处理轮次并刷新会话。events 模式可接收图片、语音、视频和文件并交给 Agent，也能把 Agent 输出文件发回飞书。适合希望从飞书使用 DSH 的用户。events 需要飞书机器人和已认证的 lark-cli；relay 需要服务地址和 DSH_FEISHU_RELAY_KEY。

dsh-feishu connects DSH to Feishu IM through lark-cli events or HTTP relay. It keeps an Agent per chat, serializes turns, and flushes sessions. Events passes media in and files out. Events needs a Feishu bot and authenticated lark-cli; relay needs a URL and DSH_FEISHU_RELAY_KEY.
我想直接在飞书里和 DSH 聊天。
能不能把飞书消息交给 DSH 的默认模型回答？
I want to send prompts to DSH from a Feishu chat and get its replies there.
dsh-feishu 的功能「飞书消息对话」：将收到的聊天文本交给该聊天对应的常驻 Agent，再把模型回复发回飞书；群聊可默认只响应 @提及。消息由 lark-cli events 通道接收。
dsh-feishu 的功能「媒体与文件收发」：events 模式把飞书消息中的媒体下载到工作区 media 子目录，并将本地路径交给 Agent；Agent 回复里的文件标记会触发图片或普通文件发送回聊天。
dsh-feishu 使用 relay 模式时，会把聊天任务发送到配置的 relay 服务，并把 Agent 回复回传；代码默认示例主机为 xxx.aiforce.cloud，实际地址由 relayBaseUrl 决定。
dsh-feishu 的 relay API key 从 DSH_FEISHU_RELAY_KEY 环境变量读取（可由 relayApiKeyEnv 改名），并作为 Bearer 标头发送给 relay；密钥不从 bundle 配置读取。

dsh-feishu README · dsh-feishu：> Part of the **DSH ecosystem** — channel plugins built on the [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://npm.im/@deepseek-ai/dsh) plugin architecture.

Feishu (Lark) IM channel bridge for the [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://npm.im/@deepseek-ai/dsh) — turn `dsh` into a Feishu bot with **one long-lived Agent per chat** (true rolling memory, flushed to disk).

dsh-feishu README · What it does：- **`events` mode** (default): consumes `im.message.receive_v1` directly via `lark-cli` on the same machine. Requires this machine to own the app's single global event-bus connection, and `lark-cli` authenticated as the bot (`lark-cli auth login`).
- **`relay` mode**: long-polls a public HTTP job relay, so the DSH machine can sit behind NAT. A Feishu-side bot (e.g. an OpenClaw/Clawdbot agent, or any webhook forwarder) POSTs user tasks to the relay; this bridge claims jobs, answers with the host's default model, and POSTs replies back. Both sides connect **outbound only**.

dsh-feishu README · What it does：Both modes share the same core: per-chat resident Agents, serialized turns per chat, event deduplication, exponential-backoff self-healing, group-chat @-mention gating (events mode), and reply-length capping.

dsh-feishu README · Configure (your profile's cordis.patch.yml)：The bundle itself is environment-agnostic — all deployment values live in
your profile's user patch layer:

```yaml
- id: feishu-bridge
  config:
    mode: events                # or: relay
    # --- relay mode ---

The relay API key is **never** stored in config files — export it before boot:

```bash
export DSH_FEISHU_RELAY_KEY=...   # then: dsh --profile feishu
```

dsh-feishu README · Relay server contract：`relay` mode needs a public HTTP endpoint implementing five routes
(a reference implementation as a Miaoda/Feishu 妙搭 full_stack NestJS app is
easy to assemble; auth via `Authorization: Bearer <key>` at the gateway):

dsh-feishu README · Relay server contract：| Route | Who calls | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /ask` `{chat_key, text, wait_seconds}` | Feishu-side bot | Submit a task, long-poll the reply |
| `GET /poll?wait=25` | this bridge | Claim pending jobs |
| `POST /reply` `{job_id, reply}` | this bridge | Return the Agent's answer |
| `GET /result/{job_id}` | Feishu-side bot | Re-check after an `ask` timeout |
| `GET /health` | anyone | Liveness |

dsh-feishu README · Events-mode prerequisites：1. A Feishu custom app with bot capability; subscribe event
   `im.message.receive_v1`; grant `im:message.p2p_msg:readonly` (+ send scopes for the bot).
2. `lark-cli` installed and authenticated (`lark-cli auth login`, bot identity ready).
3. Only ONE event bus may connect per app globally — stop any competing
   consumer (e.g. a cloud OpenClaw instance using the same app) first.

dsh-feishu README · Media (v0.2, events mode)：- Inbound image/voice/video/file messages are downloaded (via
  `lark-cli im +messages-mget --download-resources`) into
  `<workspace>/media/` and the Agent is told the local path.
- Outbound, the Agent emits `[[fsfile:/absolute/path]]` markers; the bridge
  routes images as image messages, everything else as file attachments.
- Relay mode stays text-only in v0.2 (extend the relay job schema if you need
  media there).

dsh-feishu README · Behavior notes：- One Agent per `chat_id` (events) / `chat_key` (relay), created lazily on
  first message, memory lives for the process lifetime; sessions persist to
  the DSH session store (`~/.dsh/sessions`).
- Group chats are only answered when the message @-mentions the bot
  (set `mentionOnlyInGroups: false` to answer everything).
- Model: whatever the host's default model selection is
  (`agent-default-model` in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`).
